name: web-fashion-homepage-desktop-and-mobile-with-lavender-hero
title: Fashion homepage with periwinkle gradient hero, product rows and statement headlines
whatItIs: A dark backdrop with a large uppercase intro statement and a long white homepage beside a mobile version. The hero has huge white 'STYLISH LIFE' letters behind a model in a periwinkle fleece on a lavender gradient; below are a new arrivals row, an uppercase mid-page statement, a mosaic of tinted model photos with Shop Now circles, and a split offer block.
whatItMeans: Crisp and youthful; each model sits on a gradient that ties to one blue-violet palette.
techniques: Put a giant headline behind a cutout model on a gradient.
Give each product photo a different tint from the same blue family.
Use round white Shop Now buttons on the images.
Break the page with centred uppercase statements.

vocabulary.definition: Large text placed behind a cutout person.
A grid of photos coloured from one palette.
A small circular button on an image.
A centred all-caps sentence acting as a divider.
